verdict.rationale: Grafana documents ad-hoc exploration of telemetry through Explore, with split views that compare queries and data sources side by side. Its log store, Loki, has LogQL, a documented query language that filters with labels and operators. Mimir supports running queries over Prometheus/OpenTelemetry metrics. Two community reports (one log, posted twice) say a user could not explore logs in hosted Grafana at the 2018 launch, and another user cites a lack of documentation for pulling data; neither concretely shows the query capability missing today. missing for 10: in-depth query-language reference evidence beyond a one-line LogQL description (no PromQL/TraceQL syntax docs in the pack), and independent hands-on confirmation of ad-hoc querying.

support.subject: As a developer, I can analyze telemetry ad hoc with a documented query language

citations.quote: Explore your data through ad-hoc queries and dynamic drilldown.
